title: Charting a bullish September backdrop: S&P -2-

organizations.name: company symbol date profiled honeywell international, inc

text:
Technically, the shares have recently gapped to record territory, punctuating a steep August break atop the March peak.
The subsequent pullback has been comparably flat, placing the shares at an attractive entry near gap support and 12.9% under the August peak. Consider that the September low has registered just six cents above the top of the gap (46.55).
Still well positioned
